hotels.name: Brijrama Heritage Palace
hotels.description: One of the oldest landmarks on the sacred riverfront of Varanasi, Brijrama Palace is an architectural marvel built in 1812 by the Royal House of Nagpur. Accessible exclusively by private riverboat, this heritage sanctuary offers hand-carved sandstone corridors, classical sitar recitals at twilight, royal dining at Darbhanga, and unparalleled sunrise views over the holy Ganga.
hotels.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Non-refundable thereafter.

owner.name: Pandit Shailendra Nath Mishra
owner.checkInInstructions: Private royal Bajra boat will await you at Rajghat or Assi Ghat jetty with liveried luggage porters. Classical sitar welcome and royal saffron thandai served upon arrival at Darbhanga Ghat.

hotels.name: The Rajvilas Oberoi Resort
hotels.tagline: Fort-style royal sanctuary spread across 32 acres of lush gardens
hotels.description: Built in the regal architectural idiom of traditional Rajasthan, The Rajvilas features Mughal pavilions, reflection pools, and manicured courtyards. Experience authentic pink sandstone architecture, private plunge pools, royal archery, and decadent Rajasthani thalis prepared by royal master chefs.
hotels.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 72 hours before check-in.

owner.name: Kunwar Ranvijay Singh Rathore
owner.checkInInstructions: Arrive via the grand fort gateway. Valet chauffeur service is complimentary. Our courtyard concierge will greet you with a fragrant marigold garland, traditional aarti, and sandalwood tikka ceremony.

hotels.name: Villa Capella Azure Bay
hotels.tagline: Private cliffside luxury villas overlooking the Arabian Sea
hotels.description: Perched on the serene cliffs of North Goa, Villa Capella Azure Bay blends Portuguese colonial elegance with barefoot tropical luxury. Floor-to-ceiling glass reveals uninterrupted ocean sunsets, infinity lap pools, personalized mixologist cocktails, and direct beach access.
hotels.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 5 days prior to arrival.

owner.name: Maria Clarissa Fernandez
owner.role: Managing Villa Owner & Coastal Experience Lead
owner.checkInInstructions: Drive directly up the private cliffside lane to Villa Capella gates. Direct keyless or host check-in is available. Chilled tender coconut water and Portuguese fado music await your private poolside arrival.

hotels.name: The Imperial Lutyens
hotels.tagline: Iconic art deco heritage grand hotel in the heart of the capital
hotels.description: An oasis of calm amidst the vibrant energy of New Delhi, The Imperial showcases world-class colonial charm, sprawling royal palm gardens, award-winning restaurants including 1911 and Spice Route, and a museum-quality art collection spanning the British Raj.
hotels.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before check-in.

owner.name: Vikramaditya Oberoi Sen
owner.checkInInstructions: Pull up to the Royal Portico under the imperial palm drive. Our Chief Clefs d'Or Concierge coordinates instant VIP escort straight to your heritage suite with priority registration in your salon.

hotels.name: The Marine Bay Palace
hotels.tagline: Stately waterfront elegance overlooking Marine Drive & Queen's Necklace
hotels.description: Standing proudly along the Arabian Sea waterfront in South Mumbai, The Marine Bay Palace commands breathtaking ocean vistas. With legendary hospitality, Michelin-calibre dining, and lavish suites, it represents Mumbai luxury at its finest.
hotels.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours prior to arrival.

owner.name: Farokh J. Cama
owner.checkInInstructions: Valet greets you at the historic sea-facing driveway opposite Gateway of India. Personal butler introduces you to sea-view suite amenities and schedules your evening sunset tea.

hotels.name: Amarvilas Taj Estate
hotels.tagline: Uninterrupted private balconies facing the majestic Taj Mahal
hotels.description: Located just 600 meters from the Taj Mahal, every single guest room and villa at Amarvilas offers unobstructed views of the world wonder. Inspired by Moorish and Mughal architecture, with cascading fountains, terraced lawns, and royal pavilions.
hotels.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 72 hours before check-in.

owner.name: Aditya Pratap Shekhawat
owner.checkInInstructions: Private battery-operated golf buggies escort guests from security gates directly to the Mughal terrace. Unobstructed Taj Mahal view binoculars and champagne flutes provided upon entering your private balcony.

hotels.name: The Himalayan Cedar Chalet
hotels.tagline: Gothic castle and cedar timber chalets amidst snow-capped peaks
hotels.description: Set at 2,000 meters elevation amidst apple orchards and towering deodar cedars, this European-style stone castle retreat offers wood-burning fireplaces, panoramic Pir Panjal mountain panoramas, heated alpine pool, and guided valley expeditions.
hotels.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in.

owner.name: Captain Tenzing Dorjee Thakur
owner.checkInInstructions: 4x4 snow-assist vehicles meet you in Old Manali. The fireplace is pre-lit with aromatic cedar logs, and hot spiced Kashmiri Kahwa tea is served at check-in.

hotels.name: The Leela Garden Palace
hotels.tagline: Artisanal grand palace surrounded by nine acres of tropical gardens
hotels.description: Drawing architectural grandeur from the royal Mysore Palace, The Leela Bengaluru is adorned with copper domes, ornate arches, gold leaf ceilings, and ornate crystal chandeliers, combining modern silicon city convenience with majestic heritage warmth.
hotels.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before check-in.

owner.name: Rohini Devaraj Urs
owner.checkInInstructions: Arrive at the grand Mysore-domed reception. Executive Club guests enjoy express check-in on the 6th floor Royal Club lounge with complimentary high tea and botanical garden vistas.

rooms.description: Expansive royal suite with antique jharokha balcony directly overlooking the sacred Ganga. Hand-painted fresco ceilings and Carrara marble ensuite.
Warm sandstone chamber featuring traditional brass detailing, handcrafted silk furnishings, and serene inner courtyard views.
Luxury air-conditioned canopied pavilion with embroidered Mughal draperies, teakwood floors, and private walled garden courtyard.
Spacious sandstone retreat with sunken marble bath overlooking traditional lily ponds and flaming mashaal torches.
Private 1-bedroom villa with cantilevered sundeck, plunge pool, and floor-to-ceiling vistas of the azure Arabian Sea waves.
Artisanal Portuguese villa suite with terracotta tiled roof, hammock veranda, and tropical bougainvillea garden surroundings.
Grand suite showcasing original colonial art pieces, high ceilings, separate drawing room, and dining lounge.
Classic art-deco appointed room with mahogany writing desk, Italian marble bathroom, and garden outlook.
Panoramic corner suite framing the Gateway of India and Arabian Sea yachts. Italian marble ensuite with sea-view soaking tub.
Elegantly furnished luxury room with plush velvet furnishings, high-speed connectivity, and Colaba heritage views.
Exclusive suite featuring a private open-air terrace with an uninterrupted, front-row view of the Taj Mahal monument.
Opulent room with arched doorways, hand-tufted carpets, and direct views of the terraced fountains and Mughal gardens.
Two-story wooden cottage nestled in ancient apple orchards with stone fireplace, heated floorboards, and glacier mountain vistas.
Cozy timber retreat with bay window daybed overlooking snow peaks, plush duvet bedding, and warm pine interiors.
Palatial suite featuring Mysore-inspired brass and mother-of-pearl craftsmanship, personal dining rotunda, and spa bath.
Peaceful luxury sanctuary overlooking 9 acres of blooming tropical greenery, water lilies, and palms.

reviews.title: Unmatched spiritual luxury by the Ganga
reviews.comment: Arriving at Brijrama Palace on a private wooden boat at sunset was unforgettable. The flute melodies at dusk, the view of evening Ganga Aarti from our jharokha balcony, and the impeccable staff made this the finest stay of our lives.

reviews.title: True royal treatment like kings and queens
reviews.comment: The luxury tents at Rajvilas are beyond words. The attention to detail, private garden dinner under starlit skies, and warm hospitality represent the pinnacle of Indian hospitality.

reviews.title: Breathtaking ocean views and serenity
reviews.comment: Far away from crowded tourist spots, Villa Capella in Goa offered peace and sheer comfort. Waking up to crashing waves and watching the sunset from the cliffside pool was magical.

reviews.title: Waking up to the Taj Mahal from our bed
reviews.comment: There is nothing in the world comparable to drinking morning tea on the balcony watching dawn illuminate the Taj Mahal dome. Worth every rupee.
